_comment: An item that draws nothing. A menu whose surface is painted into the inventory title (docs/presentation.md section 2) still needs an item in each slot for the hover tooltip and the click, and a vanilla item would draw its icon over the art. Select it with an item_model component of "nordtal:blank" - BlankItem in :paper-common is the one place that does. minecraft:empty is the item-model type that renders nothing, available since 1.21.4.
